scope: Native operating-system filesystem access and formatting capabilities. This is separate from DJ-player support and from this toolkit's tested adapters.

filesystems.name: FAT16
notes: Capacity and cluster-size limits apply; use device-specific documentation before selecting a DJ preset.

filesystems.name: FAT32
notes: The filesystem's per-file limit differs from the formatting application's volume-size limit. Windows formatting limits vary by tool and release.

filesystems.name: exFAT
notes: Computer interoperability does not establish support on a particular DJ player.

filesystems.name: NTFS
notes: Apple states that a Mac might read an NTFS drive but cannot write to it using native Disk Utility support; third-party drivers are outside this native matrix.

filesystems.name: HFS+ / Mac OS Extended
notes: Legacy HFS+ formatting availability depends on the installed macOS/Disk Utility version. Windows native Storage APIs do not offer this filesystem. Journaled/case-sensitive variants require separate player confirmation.

filesystems.name: APFS
notes: APFS support on macOS does not imply DJ-player support; encrypted volumes need additional device-specific confirmation.

filesystems.name: ReFS
notes: ReFS is not a portable DJ USB preset. Edition, storage topology, media type and current Windows restrictions must be checked at runtime.

filesystems.name: UDF
notes: Optical-image UDF handling is different from formatting a removable DJ drive; Mac write/format support is not certified by this dataset.

filesystems.name: ext4

windows.optionalAdapter: WSL 2 can attach supported non-system Linux disks; this is not native Windows volume support.

notes: Linux-native formatting is a separate platform adapter. Do not infer cross-platform or DJ-player compatibility from a Linux installer using ext4.
